entities.summary: Tudhaliya was an economist or social scientist of the Classical era, active in Kussara. He was a key figure associated with the development of monarchs & rulers, contributing significantly to our understanding of the political and economic systems of the time. His work had a lasting impact on the fields of governance and social organization, shaping the way future scholars approached these topics. The legacy of Tudhaliya can be seen in the many empires that rose and fell throughout history, each leaving behind a unique set of political structures and economic systems. As a leading figure in the field of monarchs & rulers, Tudhaliya's work continues to be studied by scholars today, offering valuable insights into the complexities of human governance.
